status: Source-derived geometry fixed; enclosure interference checks and physical assembly measurement pending.
coordinate_system: Carrier top view: origin at the top-left corner of the rectangular envelope; x increases right, y increases down. Local z=0 is the carrier underside. The enclosure applies its own base translation.

controller.mount: Two socketed 1x7 headers, 2.54 mm pitch, 15.24 mm row spacing.
controller.module_height_above_own_pcb: Use the official STEP model to establish USB, antenna connector, and button envelopes. The v1.3 native PCB specifies 1.6 mm thickness.
controller.power: USB-C only. BAT pads and the 5 V header pin are unused. Native USB provides programming and debug. BOOT and RESET are accessible with the lid removed.
controller.board_geometry_note: Native v1.3 Edge.Cuts centerline, aligned to the actual header center. Nominal vendor envelope is 21 x 17.8 mm. Native KiCad thickness is 1.6 mm; older 2023 STEP uses 1.0 mm. The package uses the larger thickness and a conservative USB height envelope.
controller.header_fit_note: BHS round 0.46 mm module tails fit the native 0.85 mm XIAO holes; 3.18 mm mating length lies inside the HSS socket insertion specification. The earlier square-pin TSW/SSW proposal was rejected before release. Do not substitute generic square-pin headers.

display.top_view_transform: Eagle manufacturer XY: (x,y) -> (35+x,38.25-y), viewed from the display face. Dimensions include the mounting tabs.
display.mount: Lid-mounted with four M2 screws. No OLED mounting holes are required in the carrier. Allow a removable lid and a 100 mm STEMMA QT cable loop.
display.address_setting: Bridge SJ3/ADDR to connect SA0 to GND. Keep the factory I2C mode jumpers SJ1 and SJ2 closed. Confirm address 0x3C with a scanner after assembly.
display.interface: JST SH 4-pin (STEMMA QT): pin 1 GND, pin 2 3V3, pin 3 SDA, pin 4 SCL.
display.display_area_source: The exact UG-2864HSWEG01_0.96IN_WRAPAROUND package in the official Eagle board defines glass and active-area positions. Mechanics derives the lid window from these geometries.

carrier_connector.facing: Toward the display, right (+X). Reserve the cable and service corridor x=26..36, y=15..34.
carrier_connector.mate: Adafruit product 4210, STEMMA QT / Qwiic JST SH 4-pin cable, 100 mm long.

mechanical_notes: Local Z=0 is the carrier underside. The enclosure assembly applies its current CAD-defined carrier elevation.
Keep the supplied external RF antenna separate; the package firmware keeps RF disabled.
All carrier mounts have a 3.5 mm component/copper exclusion radius.
HSS tails extend 1.58 mm below the 1.6 mm carrier before solder.
The source-derived mated board gap is 9.77 mm. Verify the actual gap during physical assembly.
